It introduced the [[Crook Boss]] rework, alongside multiple other smaller changes and fixes. This version encompassed four updates, the main v1.13.0 update (released 10 February 2024) and three minor updates, the v1.13.0a (released 11 February 2024), v1.13.0b (released 12 February 2024) and v1.13.0c (released 17 February 2024). ==Additions== ===Units=== *New units added as part of the [[Crook Boss]] rework. **[[Pistol Goon|Goon1]] **[[Tommy Goon 1|Goon2]] **[[Tommy Goon 2|Goon3]] Gamer''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|8,500}} to {{Money|17,500}}. ****Range increased from +0 to +2.5. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.125 > 0.1|-0.025}} to {{Tooltip|0.15 > 100 BOSS'' to "Lvl. 4 GOD''. *All [[Crook Boss]] skins Level 0-4 appearance changed. *Added unit skins for all [[Crook Boss]] skins. *All [[Military Base]], [[Mecha Base]], [[Engineer]], [[Elf Camp]], [[Necromancer]] units and the [[Monster]] unit now have hidden detection, if they did not have it already. *[[Lovely Crate]] is now on sale. *Units are now streamed into the client, improving performance. *Updated the appearance of unit range. *New {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} [[Commander]] skin voice lines. *Updated all [[Pyromancer]] and [[Minigunner]] icons, and the {{Color|Lunar|Masquerade}} [[DJ Booth]] icon. *[[Jester]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] gamepasses taken offsale. *Fixed [[Military Base]] not spawning the [[Humvee 2]]. *Fixed [[Crook Boss]] not spawning any units. *Fixed [[Golden Crook Boss]] not spawning units. *Fixed {{Color|Halloween|Necromancer}} [[Crook Boss]] skin having a second muzzle flash that is always active. *Fixed [[Necromancer]] gravestones being invisible. *Fixed [[Necromancer]] projectiles being invisible. *Fixed [[Archer]] projectiles being invisible. *Fixed {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Commander]] not playing the ''Come on!'' voice line. :In '''v1.13.0a''': *{{Color|ContentCreator|Elite}} [[Accelerator]] Level 5 appearance changed. *Fixed [[Electroshocker]] not appearing when placed down but still taking up placement space. *Fixed [[Fallen Swordmaster]] not spawning. *Fixed [[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] and [[Health Cultist]] getting stuck at the exit and them not being able to be targeted by towers. :In '''v1.13.0b''': *Removed hidden detection from all [[Engineer]] sentries. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} CBRThumbnail.png Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.13.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|CBRThumbnail.png|💰 CROOK BOSS REWORK 🕵️}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|✨NEW [[Crook Boss]] Skins✨}} *DRKSHDW [[Crook Boss]] *Steampunk [[Crook Boss]] {{UpdateH3|💞XOXO- Paradoxum Games}} *Re-added the [[Lovely Crate|Lovely Crate]] *Only available for a limited time of 2 weeks *10 returning skins available to collect! {{UpdateH3|🔥Reworked Crook Boss Skins}} *Demon [[Crook Boss]] *Spooky [[Crook Boss]] *Xmas [[Crook Boss]] *Holiday [[Crook Boss]] *Golden [[Crook Boss]] *Checker [[Crook Boss]] *Soviet [[Crook Boss]] *Red [[Crook Boss]] *Blue [[Crook Boss]] *Necromancer [[Crook Boss]] {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.13.0 - Image 1.png}} {{UpdateH3|💰Reworked [[Crook Boss]]}} *Improved minion spawning *[[Crook Boss]] skins have been reworked and refreshed! *There are 2 new and 10 reworked skins for the [[Crook Boss]] *Rebalances for the [[Crook Boss]] & Minions *Added [[Crook Boss]] minions skins {{UpdateH3|🔁Match Restarting}} *Once you die, you will be able to restart the match *Matches will restart with the same players *Matches will restart on the same map *In the future you will be able to vote for a new map {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.13.0 - Image 2.png}} {{UpdateH3|🛠️Improvements}} *Touched up some of the tower icons *Units are now streamed on demand to the client *Units can now have different skins *Units now have no highlights when selected *[[Necromancer]] will now spawn graves again *More bug fixes and improvements *Added missing Phantom [[Commander]] voice lines {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.13.0 - Image 3.png}} }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.13.0}} [[Category:Valentines Updates]] [[Category:Modern Updates]]
